subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
15.
The Board of Directors of a company wanted the auditor to certify Export
sales during the year for submitting to the authorities. The auditor also
signed the Confirmation letters to be sent to various debtors and creditors for
confirming their balances as on 31.03.2024.
UDIN is required to be generated by the auditor for:
(A)
Export sales during the year certificate only.
(B)
Confirmation letters only.
(C)
Both Export sales during the year certificate and Confirmation letters.
(D)  No UDIN is required to be generated.
Answer Key
MCQ No.
Correct Option
